name: writing
description: Controlled technical writing for direct prose, stable terminology, and canonical repository glossary semantics.

metadata.dailyDriver: Install when agents write or revise technical prose that needs plain language, stable terminology, or a repository glossary.
metadata.notFor: Creative or marketing copy, code changes, identifier naming, or source-backed knowledge bundle generation.
metadata.scope: Technical documentation, READMEs, pull-request text, error messages, release notes, comments, and canonical marked glossary terms.
